# Copilot Instructions

Treat [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) as mandatory repository guidance and read [docs/AGENTIC_RULES.md](../docs/AGENTIC_RULES.md) before making code changes. These rules apply to every Copilot session in this repository.

Use the existing package architecture and public APIs, keep changes focused, preserve type safety and security, avoid invented behavior or dependencies, and run the narrowest relevant validation after each substantive edit. Report only commands and results that were actually verified.
